runtimeMapping.ordinaryAndS1: Single-target Arts attacks include flyers. Normal Attack .467 and first Skill .367 events use the native maxAnimScale1 cap. S1 releases its second speed9/lifetime10 shell at triggerDelta.2 divided by capped playback, not the second literal Skill event. Source CAST selection can replace a dead input; an unlaunched all-dead input refunds its charge. NoSp ends when the final issued projectile becomes invalid; issued shells outlive source retirement.
runtimeMapping.coldAndFragile: Independent one-trigger Cold layers retain post-resistance lifetimes and consume pairing credit once; two accepted unpaired layers create canonical Freeze using their longer remaining lifetime without applying Resist twice. Frozen-immune enemies retain Cold without a Freeze attempt. The abnormal flag owns one -30 ASPD modifier, suppressed while Frozen. Source-owned range Fragile updates before damage and after status transitions, selecting the promotion/potential coefficient for Cold versus Frozen; the shared strongest-status reducer prevents stacking competing Fragile.
runtimeMapping.S2: Native charge checker compares available count GE2 after activation consumes its first charge. All remaining charge/partial SP is then cleared. Uncharged Skill_2 and charged Skill_3 release their range-wide direct Arts output at .433 with the native uncapped playback scale. First charge adds one Cold; full charge adds one Cold to already-Cold or Frozen-immune victims, otherwise directly applies Freeze. A full second charge opts into the source red readiness diamond and Charged accessible label.
runtimeMapping.S3: Selected duration, ASPD and two-target count are retained. Native selector postFilter40 is interpreted as unfrozen Cold, ordinary, then Frozen, preserving route/taunt ordering within each class. Original Skill_4_Begin .333, eventless Loop and End .667/.433 roles are preserved. A local immediate-release attack dispatcher repeats at source BAT/ASPD after Begin because compiled eventless controller dispatch remains unrecovered. The End window is reserved within the selected duration; its release uses the SkillRuntime expiry tick boundary so the finisher precedes aura detachment. This is a bounded local scheduler, not recovered Unity frame parity.
runtimeMapping.S3FreezeAndFinal: The source-owned, unresistable Freeze holder remains only during active S3 while the eligible Frozen victim stays in range. It keeps one -15 RES reduction after the original finite Freeze expires and removes only its own effects on exit/retirement. FinalAttack checks whether the owner can act when End begins, reacquires eligible Frozen victims at release, deals selected Arts damage, then removes Freeze-family buffs after native clear_freeze .01 without owner filtering. Other status families remain intact. Unreleased End attacks cancel under brief control/retirement; SP stays blocked through the surviving End pose.
runtimeMapping.KjeragResist: The E2 selected interval10 delay enables a global source-owned .5 Resist status for eligible deployed operator recipients tagged kjerag, including the owner. This follows the nation tag rather than only group karlan; owner retirement detaches its contribution and redeployment restarts the delay.

verificationLimits: Native S3 RangedAttack has empty animKey, waitForAttackEvent1, preDelay0/timeMode0 and an eventless original Loop. Its executable continuous controller is not recovered. Local immediate release, Begin/End windows, early-finish behavior and tick ordering are explicit interpretations, not source frame parity.

Native enum-driven target ties, attack animation dispatch and action callback priorities remain unrecovered. Rank/promotions/potentials and retained prefab fields are source facts; scheduler and hooks execute in this simulator at 30Hz.

Speed9/lifetime10 shells use the existing homing-point projectile pipeline. Original muzzle, ballistic geometry, hit-radius/collider and target-invalid C# dispatch are unverified; local removal observations unlock S1.

Cold precedes the shared damage pipeline, including shield/dodge output. Original DamageMissable coupling, immunity/abnormal-dirty priority inside damage hooks and same-frame external status removal are not certified.

This opt-in producer retains independent one-use Cold pairing credits. Earlier kits keep their existing single-key Cold application; refreshing a previously paired legacy key does not yet reconstruct native independently triggered layers. No claim of complete cross-producer native Cold equivalence is made.

Fragile ownership/strongest-value fallback, unresistable holders and RES suppression map onto local buff keys and flags. Derived template hierarchy, parent-versus-child removal order and duplicate same-operator native override maps remain unverified.
Kjerag ownership, nation tags, delay and ordinary target-free legality are retained; native global selector identity, disappearance/rebirth and aura callback order remain bounded by this engine.

Modules, original Unity particles/projectiles/audio and recorded-game frame comparisons remain unfinished. This adapter enables all source skills with these declared limits; it does not claim a complete native game implementation.
